newsitem.title: UK: UK sports goods suppliers give price assurance-OFT.
newsitem.headline: UK sports goods suppliers give price assurance-OFT.

text.p: Three UK sports goods suppliers have given assurances that they will not attempt to fix minimum retail prices, said John Bridgeman, the Director General of Fair Trading, on Monday.
The assurances follow the launch of a campaign in January by the Office of Fair Trading to expose resale price maintenance in the sports goods sector.

"The campaign has been has been successful in revealing the high level of price fixing attempted in this sector, which had sales estimated at over three billion stg last year," Bridgeman said in a statement. "It is to retailers' credit that they have come forward to help us to stop this pernicious practice".
Bridgeman had urged retailers to blow the whistle on such suppliers and complaints have been made against 30 companies.

The companies which have given assurances are: Ellesse UK Ltd, a clothing and footwear supplier which is part of Pentland Group Plc ; Maver (U.K.) Ltd, a fishing tackle supplier; and Lynx Golf Europe Ltd.
Other companies are also expected to give such assurances, Bridgeman added.
